name: AI Discovers Fire
description: Media Art created using DCGAN trained on images of fire.

text: Fire was arguably humanity's first discovery, the spark that separated us from everything else. In 2021, just before the AI revolution took hold, I wanted to close that loop. What happens when you ask an artificial intelligence to discover fire for itself?

DCGAN, one of the earliest generative image models, produces outputs that feel unhinged and fluid. Artifacts of a network learning to see. Trained on hundreds of images of flames, the model learns to hallucinate fire that never existed. The results live in latent space, a hidden dimension where one imagined flame morphs seamlessly into the next.

Each frame below captures the model at a different stage of training. Early epochs produce nothing but noise and color. Gradually, shapes emerge. Warmth, movement, the flicker of something recognizable. By the final epoch, the network has taught itself to dream of fire.
